items.title: BlockStrap: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection, rated with a CVSS score of 10.0. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but it requires a manual patch, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eleven vulnerabilities, five of which are exploitable without authentication, including the critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849) leading to arbitrary code execution. It also fixes an incorrect authorization flaw in B2B allowing unauthenticated code execution (CVE-2026-92909), stored cross-site scripting, and an admin input validation flaw.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Template Engine Injection
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability, actively exploited in the wild, allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious code into Magento's template system. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler Hotfix)
items.summary: This emergency security update resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution and was being actively exploited in the wild. Adobe categorized this update with Priority 1, its highest rating.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including two stored cross-site scripting flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201) and several incorrect authorization flaws. Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Customer Account Takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges, potentially leading to customer account takeover without user interaction. It affects various 2.4.x release lines of Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, five of which are rated Critical, including CVE-2026-71362, an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Exploitation requires no existing account, administrator privileges, or user interaction.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 14 vulnerabilities, marking the first month of Adobe shipping fixes as isolated patch files rather than new -pN releases. Sansec also noted a campaign infecting 953 online shops by placing JavaScript snippets in database content blocks, recommending applying this update.
